source.title: UMI-guided single locus sequence typing method for phylotyping Cutibacterium acnes from skin samples

inspection_level: Selected main-text Results, Discussion, Methods and figure-caption anchors read from full JATS; no independent raw-data or supplementary-file analysis.

checks.section_title: SLST-Seq assigns sequences to the correct SLST type with high specificity
checks.anchor: an average of 93% of sequences were correctly assigned
checks.assessment: The reported average across six isolate preparations concerns observed sequence assignment; the remainder includes unassigned and other-type sequences, not only loss.

checks.section_title: SLST-Seq accurately quantifies SLST type composition in defined DNA mixtures
checks.assessment: Observed relative abundance of G1 is lower than the nominal defined-mixture abundance; the quotient is not an absolute recovery probability.

checks.anchor: replicate counts were combined within each mixture
checks.assessment: Technical library/sequencing replicate counts were pooled into mixture proportions; these are not independently introduced cells or mutation events.

checks.anchor: a pre-amplification of the SLST locus was performed prior to molecular barcoding
checks.assessment: Clinical skin-strip DNA has an upstream enrichment stage before UMI labeling.

checks.anchor: while mixes and controls were processed using
checks.assessment: Clinical barcoding uses pre-amplified DNA; mixes/controls enter using purified DNA. Shared downstream workflow does not establish full upstream equivalence.

checks.section_title: Quantitative accuracy is maintained at low C. acnes DNA fractions
checks.anchor: All SpikeMix samples were processed without pre-amplification
checks.assessment: SpikeMix bypasses the clinical pre-amplification stage.

checks.anchor: Families supported by ≥50 reads were assembled
checks.assessment: The output is conditioned on molecular-family support and locus/classification criteria; it is not all input molecules or original cells.
Input standards are genomic DNA concentration mixtures, not known independent introduced-cell trial denominators.

same_pipeline_caveat: The source says all mixtures use the same SLST library/sequencing/bioinformatic pipeline, but separately describes clinical pre-amplification before UMI labeling and purified-DNA inputs for mixes/controls. Upstream equivalence is not established by the general same-workflow sentence.
scope: Measurement architecture example for distinguishing assignment, relative composition, stage-specific calibration and native recovery. No TMD fit, mutation mechanism or clinical recommendation.
